description: Search saved sessions and memories. Query matches session text or memory content/id. Supports metadata filtering via tags/project/status/tool_source. Omit query for tags-only or project-only session filtering. Project match is case-insensitive.

project.description: Optional case-insensitive project filter (Logisoft ≡ logisoft). Allowed without query or tags.

query.description: Full-text search query. Omit for tags-only or project-only filtering.

tool_source.description: Optional explicit filter by tool source (cursor, claude, chatgpt, web, etc.).

name: palim_search
